title: The outside passed pawn

D0.outcome: Explains that a distant passed pawn drags the opposing king away, putting the other king two files nearer the remaining pawns.

D1.outcome: Identifies the outside passed pawn and shows the king route that wins the other pawns.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled pawn endings, decides whether the outside passer wins, using counting and the opposition, and when the passer is too close to the kings.

D3.outcome: Predicts the effect of one-feature changes (the passer one file closer; a king one step further) and verifies with counting.

misconceptions: Any passed pawn on the edge wins.
conditions: The passed pawn is far enough from the kings that the defending king must leave the other pawns.
contrasts: A passed pawn too close to the kings, so the defender's king stops it and still guards.
Pushing the passer without king support.
Active rooks where the king raid is not available.
